description: Unpaywall open-access lookup by DOI (free API; it requires a contact e-mail set in UNPAYWALL_EMAIL, not a key): is the paper open access, OA status, best free full-text link, journal and publisher. Returns metadata and links only, not the PDF. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: search_unpaywall
title: Search Unpaywall
